title: AI Delivery Pods/Squads & Engineering-Quality KPI Framework
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (synthetic clinical data / AI test enablement; data-engineering/simulation/governance work, privacy care).

Synthetic-data & digital-twin tools (e.g. Synthea, commercial platforms) and AI/model frameworks integrated at the pattern level; vendor internals cited or deferred, never invented. Regulatory/legal interpretation (HIPAA/HITRUST de-identification, IRB/privacy sign-off, disclosure risk) deferred to privacy/compliance/legal. Never real PHI in a shared harness/twin/AI test env. Automation is Python.
hook: Structure AI delivery teams and prove quality with KPIs
problem: Delivering AI at pace needs the right team structure and the right measures. This solution provides an AI delivery pods/squads and engineering-quality KPI framework: how to structure pods/squads for AI delivery, the roles and interfaces, and the KPIs that actually improve engineering productivity and delivery quality — with definitions, targets, and dashboards — so leaders can organize AI delivery and measure whether it's getting better.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the AI-delivery operating model: pods/squads, roles/interfaces, and the productivity + delivery-quality measurement approach.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (delivery teams, data sources for KPIs, tooling, sponsorship).
Implementation Guide — define the pod/squad structure and interfaces, select and define the KPI set (productivity + quality), set targets and dashboards, and run an improvement cadence, pilot-first.

5 Python tools — assessment/profiling, generation or scenario execution, a fidelity/coverage report, a privacy/validation check, and a scope/config helper — authentic to synthetic-data engineering (safe by default; no real PHI written to shared locations).
Testing/validation gates (structure defined, KPIs instrumented, cadence running) plus Best Practices for KPI hygiene and avoiding vanity metrics.
short: An AI delivery pods/squads and engineering-quality KPI framework — team structure, roles/interfaces, and the KPIs that improve productivity and delivery quality, with targets and dashboards. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
